title: Tile footprints and per-quarter coverage
description:
Lists which mosaic tiles of the `mosaics` collection exist in each quarter, with one table row per tile per quarter and one polygon per tile. Clients can use it to find which quarters cover a place, or how much of a tile has valid pixels, without listing the million-object prefix or opening 36 rasters.

`tiles.parquet` is sorted by tile and then quarter, so one tile's history is a contiguous run that a single range read returns. Its size columns come from the transfer manifests, which record the byte size of every transferred object. `valid_fraction` is the only column read from the rasters. It counts pixels that are not the `-32768` nodata value on the smallest internal overview of the red band (313 x 313 pixels), a 0.1-megapixel read per tile instead of 100 megapixels.

`footprints.pmtiles` has one polygon per mosaic tile, using the tile's footprint geometry rather than its bounding box, and the number of quarters in which the tile is present. Clients join the table to it on `subtile`, so recomputing the statistics does not require rebuilding the tileset.

On 2026-11-04 the table had 1,017,575 rows across 34,916 mosaic tiles and 36 quarters (2017 Q1 through 2025 Q4), one row for every tile in the mirror. `valid_fraction` is measured for 72,000 rows and NULL for the rest. The `footprints` layer has 34,916 features. The table covers only 2017–2025, so a missing row for another year says nothing about whether imagery exists.

Derived from the Copernicus Sentinel-2 Global Mosaics. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

providers.name: European Space Agency (ESA)
providers.description: Operates the Sentinel-2 mission and produces the Global Mosaics these statistics are measured from.

providers.name: European Commission

providers.name: Taylor Geospatial Engine
providers.description: Aggregates the mirrored mosaic tiles into per-quarter coverage statistics and a tile-footprint PMTiles, and hosts both.

table:columns.name: subtile
table:columns.description: The mosaic tile id, `{MGRS}_{i}_{j}`, for example `31UFU_0_0`. Join key against the `footprints.pmtiles` feature property `subtile` and against `_subtile` in the mosaics item index. With `quarter`, it is the unique key of this table.

table:columns.name: mgrs_tile
table:columns.description: The bare MGRS grid cell, for example `31UFU`. Not unique: one cell can carry more than one mosaic tile.

table:columns.name: year
table:columns.description: Calendar year of the quarter, 2017 to 2025.

table:columns.name: quarter
table:columns.description: The quarter as `YYYY.Qn`, for example `2024.Q2`. The same value the mosaics collection partitions on.

table:columns.name: bytes_total
table:columns.description: Sum of the four band files for this tile and quarter, in bytes, from the transfer manifest. A useful proxy for how much real signal a tile holds: an almost empty tile compresses far smaller than a full one.

table:columns.name: bytes_b02
table:columns.description: Size of the blue COG in bytes, from the transfer manifest.

table:columns.name: bytes_b03
table:columns.description: Size of the green COG in bytes, from the transfer manifest.

table:columns.name: bytes_b04
table:columns.description: Size of the red COG in bytes, from the transfer manifest.

table:columns.name: bytes_b08
table:columns.description: Size of the near-infrared COG in bytes, from the transfer manifest.

table:columns.name: valid_fraction
table:columns.description: Fraction of the tile that carries a real value rather than nodata, from 0.0 to 1.0. Measured on the smallest internal overview of the red band, 313 x 313 pixels, by counting pixels not equal to -32768. It is an estimate at that resolution, not an exact pixel count of the full raster. NULL where the overview has not been read yet.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: The mosaic tile footprint in EPSG:4326, as a Polygon or, for tiles crossing the antimeridian, a MultiPolygon split at 180 degrees. The same geometry the PMTiles carries. Last column in the file, and the table's primary geometry.

data.title: Per-tile, per-quarter coverage table
data.description: One row per mosaic tile per quarter, sorted by subtile then quarter so one tile's available history is a contiguous run.

pmtiles.title: Mosaic tile footprints
pmtiles.description: One polygon per mosaic tile, on the true mosaic grid, carrying the count of quarters present. Join the coverage table onto it by `subtile`.

style-default.title: Default MapLibre style
style-default.description: Paints each mosaic tile by `quarters_present` in six steps, so the map reads as how much of the 36-quarter record covers a place rather than as a flat footprint.

thumbnail.title: Mosaic tile coverage, 2017 Q1 to 2025 Q4
thumbnail.description: Number of distinct quarters per subtile, rendered from the published tiles.parquet on 2026-11-04 in Web Mercator with the default style's fill colours, opacity, and background. It shows 34,916 footprints across 36 quarters. Color shows how many quarters include each tile, not the fraction of valid pixels.
